name: Two-Sided Marketplace Platform
description: For two-sided marketplace platforms that connect supply and demand. Distinct teams focus on supply-side growth and demand-side growth, each with their own strategy and metrics. Trust and Safety is a critical function, alongside payments/financial operations and community management. Deeply integrated data science teams drive matching, ranking, and personalization algorithms.

org_structure.overview: Marketplaces are uniquely challenging because they must simultaneously grow two distinct user bases — supply and demand — while keeping them balanced. The philosophy is 'always bias toward liquidity' — every team's success is ultimately measured by transaction volume and marketplace health metrics. The org is structured around supply/demand specialization: separate growth teams for each side, separate product managers, and separate data scientists who live and breathe their side's unit economics. Trust and Safety operates as a critical enabling function — in a marketplace, a single bad experience can cause cascading churn on both sides. The marketplace team structure scales through 'squadification': cross-functional pods organized around marketplace levers (e.g., Search & Discovery, Transactions, Trust, Supply Growth) rather than by technical layer.

departments.name: Marketplace Leadership
departments.description: Executive team that balances supply and demand strategy, sets marketplace health metrics (liquidity, take rate, GMV/NMV), and ensures cross-side optimization.

roles.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
roles.description: Sets marketplace vision, owns the supply/demand balance, and is accountable for GMV, take rate, and marketplace liquidity.

roles.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
roles.description: Operationalizes marketplace strategy. Owns marketplace health metrics, trust and safety, and community operations.

roles.title: Chief Data Officer (CDO) / Head of Data Science
roles.description: Owns data infrastructure, ML models for matching/ranking/recommendation, experimentation platform, and marketplace analytics.

departments.name: Supply-Side Growth
departments.description: Owns acquisition, onboarding, retention, and quality of supply-side participants (e.g., hosts, drivers, sellers, contractors). Deep focus on supply unit economics.

roles.title: VP of Supply Growth
roles.description: Supply-side strategy, acquisition channels, onboarding funnel, and supply quality management.

roles.title: Supply Acquisition Manager
roles.description: Runs supply acquisition campaigns, referral programs, and supply-side marketing.

roles.title: Supply Onboarding & Quality Lead
roles.description: Designs and optimizes supply onboarding flow. Manages supply vetting, verification, and quality scoring processes.

roles.title: Supply-Side Product Manager
roles.reports_to: VP of Supply Growth / Head of Product
roles.description: Builds tools for supply participants: dashboards, scheduling, earnings insights, and communication features.

departments.name: Demand-Side Growth
departments.description: Owns acquisition, activation, retention, and spend of demand-side users (e.g., guests, riders, buyers, seekers). Focuses on demand-side unit economics and LTV optimization.

roles.title: VP of Demand Growth
roles.description: Demand-side strategy, user acquisition, SEO/SEM, lifecycle marketing, and retention optimization.

roles.title: Performance Marketing Manager
roles.description: Paid acquisition across channels (Google, Facebook, TikTok, affiliates). Optimizes CAC by channel and segment.

roles.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
roles.description: Email, push, and in-app messaging campaigns to drive activation, repeat usage, and reactivation.

roles.title: Demand-Side Product Manager
roles.reports_to: VP of Demand Growth / Head of Product
roles.description: Builds consumer-facing product: search, browse, booking/purchase flow, and personalization.

departments.name: Trust & Safety
departments.description: Critical marketplace function that ensures safe interactions between supply and demand. Includes fraud prevention, content moderation, dispute resolution, and insurance/guarantees.

roles.title: Head of Trust & Safety
roles.description: Trust and safety strategy, safety policies, risk scoring, and moderation operations.

roles.title: Trust & Safety Operations Manager
roles.description: Manages moderation team, dispute resolution, and fraud investigation workflows.

roles.title: Content Moderator / Trust & Safety Specialist
roles.description: Reviews listings, profiles, and transactions for policy violations. Handles user reports and escalations.

roles.title: Trust & Safety Product Manager
roles.reports_to: Head of T&S / Head of Product
roles.description: Builds safety features: identity verification, reputation systems, reporting flows, and automated detection systems.

departments.name: Data Science & Marketplace Analytics
departments.description: Core to marketplace operations. Builds and maintains matching/ranking algorithms, dynamic pricing models, fraud detection ML, and experimentation infrastructure.

roles.title: Head of Data Science (Marketplace)
roles.description: Data science strategy for marketplace algorithms: search ranking, matching, dynamic pricing, and personalization.

roles.title: Data Scientist (Matching / Ranking)
roles.description: Builds and tunes ML models for search ranking, recommendation, and supply/demand matching.

roles.title: Data Scientist (Pricing / Incentives)
roles.description: Develops dynamic pricing models, surge pricing, incentives optimization, and promotion effectiveness analysis.

roles.title: Data Engineer
roles.description: Builds and maintains data pipelines, feature stores, experimentation framework, and business intelligence infrastructure.

roles.title: Marketplace Analyst
roles.description: Produces marketplace health dashboards, liquidity metrics, funnel analysis, and ad-hoc business insights for leadership.

departments.name: Payments & Financial Operations
departments.description: Manages the payment flow between demand and supply participants. Handles payout timing, escrow, dispute holds, and marketplace financial reporting.

roles.title: Head of Marketplace Payments
roles.description: Payment flow strategy, payout scheduling, payment method optimization, and cross-border payment setup.

roles.title: Payments Operations Analyst
roles.description: Manages payment reconciliation, dispute holds, payout exceptions, and merchant onboarding/compliance.

roles.title: Financial Reporting Analyst (Marketplace)
roles.description: Revenue recognition for marketplace fees/commissions, supply-side payouts accounting, and regulatory financial reporting.

departments.name: Community Management
departments.description: Builds and nurtures the marketplace community on both sides. Manages communication forums, events, ambassador programs, and user feedback loops.

roles.title: Head of Community
roles.description: Community strategy, engagement programs, ambassador/advocate programs, and community health metrics.

roles.title: Community Manager
roles.description: Manages community forums, social media groups, events, and user feedback collection.

key_relationships: Supply Growth and Demand Growth teams are intentionally separate but must coordinate on marketplace balance and incentives to avoid subsidizing one side at the expense of the other.
Data Science is embedded in every major squad: matching/ranking DS works with Demand PM, pricing DS works with Supply and Finance, T&S DS works with Trust teams.
Trust and Safety has the authority to block a launch or feature release if safety requirements aren't met, with escalation to the COO/CEO.
Payments works closely with Trust & Safety on fraud detection and dispute resolution — the two teams share data and alerting systems.
Community Management feeds qualitative insights from both sides to Product teams, often surfacing issues before quantitative metrics show them.
The CEO or COO chairs a weekly Marketplace Health review where all teams review liquidity, conversion, take rate, and supply/demand balance metrics.
Marketplace analysts produce a single source of truth dashboard that all teams use, preventing metric fragmentation across side-specific reporting.
